original.target_description: Study 3, San Diego County (Red county): chi-square comparison of the Democratic-to-Republican bumper-sticker ratio with the Democratic-to-Republican registered-voter ratio; descriptive deviants are Republican sticker holders.

n.sample_role: Bumper-sticker-bearing vehicles / sticker holders in San Diego County included in the county-specific chi-square test (10 Democratic, 27 Republican; Table 4), not survey respondents or registered voters.
n.exclusions: One San Diego Republican sticker holder identified as a nonresident was omitted from all subsequent analyses (Method, p. 878). The test explicitly prints N = 37 after this exclusion.
n.location: Published article p. 879 (PDF p. 9), Study 3, Results and Discussion, Bumper sticker ratios; Table 4, San Diego County.
